subject: Commit cadence & conditional burst credits for Nova Retail renewal
messages:
From: Claire Tan <claire@nova-retail.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@nova-retail.com
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal timing + burst credits question

Jonas,

We’re gearing up for our annual renewal and have two priority asks from procurement + platform:

- We expect a 30–40% uplift in inference usage starting in Q3 for a pilot; can you outline whether conditional burst credits can be structured around a threshold (e.g., >150% baseline usage)?
- Procurement needs an invoice cadence that closes FY on 30 June. Can Redwood issue an invoice dated 30 June (or confirm alternative timing) so we can align internal accounting?

Also sending the procurement checklist (attached) so you can see required fields for PO/contract handoff.

Appreciate a short proposal we can review internally by next week.

Thanks,
Claire Tan
Head of Cloud Platform
Nova Retail
[attachment: procurement_checklist.docx]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Tan <claire@nova-retail.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal timing + burst credits question

Claire — thanks for the clear ask. Drafting a concise proposal below; attached is a two-page term sheet and our usage breakdown for Q1–Q2 for baseline calibration.

Proposal (high level):
- Commit cadence: 12-month renewal, with an option to step up committed units at the 6-month mark.
- Conditional burst credits: We can provide 20% free burst credits for monthly usage up to 200% of the agreed baseline for the first 3 billing cycles post-step-up, then reassess. Credits apply only to host tokens (not embeddings).
- Temporary price hold: 6-month price hold matching current list rates for committed units after signature. Any step-up pricing will be applied prospectively.
- Invoice timing: We can issue a pro-forma invoice dated 30 June that triggers your PO process; operational invoice will be dated when payment is processed. Kimberly — confirm if this works from a finance perspective.
- Next steps: If Nova agrees, we’ll produce a short addendum (1 page) that captures the burst credit trigger and invoice timing. We can route via DocuSign.

Key asks for you: confirm target committed units (monthly token equivalent) and whether procurement requires the invoice to carry a PO number before DocuSign.

Attachments: JW_Nova_renewal_proposal_v2.pdf, usage_breakdown_Q1-Q2.xlsx

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Tan <claire@nova-retail.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal timing + burst credits question

Claire / Jonas — looping in finance/legal clarifications on the two asks. Quick items inline: 

> Jonas: 
> - Invoice timing: We can support a pro-forma dated 30-Jun to help your internal close. Final operational invoice will show the actual invoice date; if Nova requires a fiscal cut for 6/30 specifically we can accommodate by issuing the invoice and routing for payment by 6/30 provided PO/approval is in place.

Action item for procurement: please confirm whether a PO number must be present on the DocuSign/contract to accept an invoice dated 6/30. If a PO is required, we need the PO no later than 6/24 to ensure processing.

> Jonas: 
> - Burst credits: We’re comfortable with a 20% burst credit up to 200% baseline for first three cycles following a step-up, but we need the trigger to be defined (baseline months, smoothing window). We suggest baseline = average monthly host tokens from Jan–Jun 2027. Also will require a short SOW addendum to define the threshold and reconciliation process.

I’ve attached a redline of the billing section to make this explicit. If Nova is okay with the approach, legal can turn the SOW addendum around in ~3–5 business days.

Attachments: billing_terms_redline.docx

Kimberly Park
Head of Finance Operations, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Tan <claire@nova-retail.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 15:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal timing + burst credits question

Claire — thanks for the call earlier today and for confirming procurement timings. Summary + next steps: 

- Nova confirmed target: 1.5x current committed monthly tokens (formal number to follow).
- Price hold: you asked for 9 months on the committed units; our proposal above included 6 months. We can extend the price hold to 9 months conditional on the 1.5x commit (i.e., executed at step-up).
- Burst credits: baseline will be Jan–Jun average host tokens; 20% burst credits up to 200% baseline for the first three billing cycles after step-up. Reconciliation monthly; unused burst credits do not roll forward.
- Invoice: Redwood will issue a pro-forma invoice dated 2027-06-30 to enable your FY close. If Nova provides the PO by 2027-06-24 we will ensure the invoice includes the PO number and route to operational invoicing accordingly.

Next steps: I attached the revised two-page term sheet (finalizing price-hold to 9 months) and will open a DocuSign envelope for the addendum and SOW. Please confirm you’re good for us to send DocuSign to procurement@nova-retail.com.

DocuSign (preview): https://docusign.com/templates/ABCD-1234
Attachments: JW_Nova_renewal_proposal_v2.pdf, usage_breakdown_Q1-Q2.xlsx

If you confirm, I’ll kick off the DocuSign and include the PO field so procurement can populate it before signing.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this for Q3 ramp.

Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
